summary: W1 makes the read-only coordination Board stop labelling an arbitrary worktree checkout HEAD as main_head, projects a four-segment version strip (checkout HEAD, verifiable origin/main, desired deployment generation/SHA, live SHA) with explicit unknown when a source cannot be verified, and aggregates append-only lane ledgers by highest lane version so a superseded historical row cannot appear as an in-flight ghost lane. Same-version conflicts and invalid versions keep failing closed into degraded, a non-boolean owner value is never treated as agreement, and historical deployment rows can no longer masquerade as the live identity. R2 hardens the same surface: a non-UTF-8 desired record degrades instead of raising, only SHA-shaped strings may be projected as a version value, the live timestamp comes solely from the authoritative receipt, and behind_main is measured against the main_head the Board actually reports. No new write authority, no admission change, no R5 relaxation, no auto-close, no deployment. R3 (GPT-6 adjudication of the Host Reviewer round-1 report): the reported P1 (missing JSONDecodeError handling in the historical deployment reader) is a demonstrable false positive and is now pinned by a counter-example test instead of by a redundant except; the three real P2 gaps are fixed - a lower-version lane conflict no longer vetoes that lane's clean highest version (historical conflict stays as degraded evidence, while a conflicting top version still fails closed), lane versions must be positive ints so bool/0/negative fail closed, and an authoritative restart receipt must carry a full 40-hex git_head_full before it can become live. Exact PR base b7aef87b014f17f0918914f590bd104a12620534.

components.owning_subsystem: Read-only coordination Board aggregation (lane_board.build_board) and its HTTP projection (coordination_routes)
components.disposition: ADMIT read-only projection correction: main_head may only be a verifiable origin/main or an explicit caller-supplied value; worktree checkout HEAD becomes its own field; desired/live identities are read from service_control's own records with explicit unknown on missing/unreadable source; live identity must come from the authoritative restart receipt, never from a historical deployment row; lane aggregation resolves append-only history by highest monotonic version and keeps same-version or invalid-version conflicts fail-closed in degraded with a non-boolean owner value treated as a conflict.
evidence: BUG-16 reproduced on production ledger: build_board(workspace_root=main worktree) reported main_head=3e0202b5b (detached PR#44 head, 37 commits behind) while deployed_sha=b7aef87b, producing a false in_sync=mismatch even though live equals origin/main.

BUG-14a reproduced: lanes.jsonl holds lane-selftest-guard active v1 and closed v2; Board showed inflight=14/13 while the version-resolved truth was 13/12 because LaneStore.list() returns rows in file order without interpreting version.

OPT-11: desired identity is read from <data>/runtime/managed_service_deployment.json and live identity from <data>/restart-receipt.json, the same authoritative sources service_control writes; missing/unreadable/invalid sources yield source=unknown plus a degraded reason instead of a substituted SHA.

P1-A negative test: with the restart receipt absent, historical deployments/batch.jsonl pre_deploy rows all carrying one SHA still leave live.source=unknown and main.verifiable=false, so a deploy log cannot stand in for the running identity.

P1-B negative test: three rows of one lane share version 2 with owner_session_id "owner-A", "owner-B" and the integer 123; the lane is dropped from inflight and reported as lane_version_conflict:lane-split3 plus summary.lane_conflicts, instead of resolving first-row/last-row wins.

Decode-path test (R2 P1): the desired deployment record is written as raw non-UTF-8 bytes (0xff 0xfe inside a JSON-looking payload); build_board must degrade with desired_deployment_unreadable:UnicodeDecodeError and desired.source=unknown instead of raising out of the Board or the HTTP route.

Unreadable-ledger test (unchanged in R2): the lane ledger holds UTF-8 text that is not valid JSON, so it exercises the json.JSONDecodeError branch - a different path from the non-UTF-8 byte test above; the two are no longer described as one test.

tests/unit/test_lane_board_version_strip.py covers detached worktree vs origin/main, origin/main absent, explicit main_head compatibility, desired/live projection, desired missing, superseded duplicate, same-version conflict, invalid version, unreadable ledger, non-boolean owner conflict, historical deploy rows not live, and the HTTP route projection.

Typed git_head gate (R2 P1): JSON true, 123, a list and an object are each rejected; desired.sha stays empty, desired.source=unknown, degraded carries desired_deployment_invalid, and deployment.desired_sha is empty - str() never turns a non-string into a SHA.

Explicit main_head baseline (R2 P2-2): with origin/main 1 commit ahead and an explicit main_head equal to the checkout HEAD, versions.worktree.behind_main is 0 (not 1); when the supplied main_head cannot be resolved as a local commit, behind_main is None instead of falling back to HEAD..origin/main.

Live timestamp gate (R2 P2-1): when the restart receipt is absent and only historical deployments rows exist, versions.live.recorded_at is empty together with sha empty and source=unknown, so a historical timestamp cannot be read as the live record.

g1.necessity: The read-only Board is the surface operators and the main agent use to decide whether the running code matches main and how many lanes are actually in flight. Labelling a detached checkout as main produced a false deployment mismatch, and first-row lane listing produced a ghost in-flight lane. Both defects mislead review and closure decisions without any operator mistake, so the projection must be corrected at its source rather than explained away.

g2.authority_owner: Git itself owns refs and commits; service_control owns desired deployment and restart receipts; LaneStore owns the append-only lane ledger and R5/goal_coordination keep owning closure and command-safety verdicts. This change only reads those sources and projects them.
g2.non_duplication: No second ledger, no cached copy of main, no Board-side deployment state machine, no lane close/approve capability, and no change to R5 source_complete or safe_to_execute semantics. Version aggregation happens per request from the existing ledger.

model_evidence: Production reproduction recorded for both defects (main_head=3e0202b5b vs origin/main=b7aef87b; inflight 14 vs version-resolved 13).

Reviewer-reported defects are pinned as tests, not as summaries: non-UTF-8 desired bytes degrade fail-closed, non-string git_head is never rendered as a SHA, the live segment never borrows a historical timestamp, behind_main uses the reported main_head baseline or None, and the manifest evidence names tests that actually exist.

The Host Reviewer's P1 ("_read_latest_deployment does not catch JSONDecodeError") was adjudicated a demonstrable false positive - the per-line handler already exists - and is pinned by test_malformed_deployment_json_line_does_not_crash rather than by adding a redundant except. The three real P2 gaps are pinned by test_lower_version_conflict_does_not_veto_higher_version, test_top_version_conflict_still_fails_closed, test_non_positive_or_bool_version_fails_closed and test_receipt_short_sha_cannot_become_live.

Earlier round still holds: historical deployment rows no longer feed the live identity, same-version owner conflicts stay fail-closed in degraded, and version lanes missing from the Board list are no longer silently skipped.

Verification is re-run, not quoted: components[0].verification_level carries the focused, adjacent, lint, type-check and A.5 validator commands. This round adds the service_control 40-char lowercase contract: a short desired SHA degrades to unknown instead of a false mismatch, and uppercase desired/live SHAs normalize before comparison (test_short_desired_sha_is_invalid_not_a_false_mismatch, test_uppercase_shas_normalize_before_comparison).

Review and R9 state is deliberately absent from this manifest: it is owned by the Goal checkpoint and the PR, and test_manifest_records_no_stale_pass_counts pins that no PASS count is ever stored here.
g3.recovery_or_reason: Every source is optional: if git probing fails, origin/main is absent, or the desired/live records are missing or malformed, the field is empty with source=unknown plus a degraded reason; the Board never substitutes a different SHA. If aggregation sees an invalid or conflicting version, that lane is excluded from counts and surfaced in degraded.

g4.rollback: Revert the branch; the Board falls back to its previous fields and the ledger is untouched.
